user.title: Connect to Nightscout
user.description: Use an access token with the **readable** role (Nightscout → Admin tools → Subjects). The API secret also works but gives full access.

data_description.url: The address you open your Nightscout site at in a browser.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty if your site is readable without signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Nightscout needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: {url} rejected the saved token or API secret.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Nightscout at that address, or it didn't answer like a Nightscout site.
error.invalid_auth: Nightscout rejected the token or API secret.

abort.already_configured: This Nightscout site is already set up.

init.description: Leave a threshold blank to use the corresponding Nightscout setting. Overrides apply to Home Assistant only and use the alarm enable settings from Nightscout.

error.invalid_alarm_threshold: Enter a positive, finite number or leave this field blank.
error.alarm_threshold_order: The combined Nightscout and Home Assistant thresholds must increase from urgent low to low, high, and urgent high. Change or clear the conflicting overrides.
